vitest.reason: poolOptions was removed in Vitest 4; only supported top-level options are renderable

command.note: preserves package lifecycle scripts; check/build/validate:openapi/generate:api are separate operations subordinate to make verify

selectors.note: runner passes filters via its own script contract; unverified until admission

isolation.checkout_mutex: Svelte sync/build/check and E2E must serialize per checkout
isolation.network: denied at test time; generation prerequisites are separate owned stages

requires_external_state.reason: unit scope only; E2E/browser and Go-backed prerequisites are separate drafts

generated: generated API/Svelte outputs own their existing recipes

notes: draft: admission requires resolving the pinned Go 1.26.5 toolchain and the declared checkout mutex; never copy AFlow Vitest 1 flags into this profile
